SELECT * FROM ( SELECT g.game_title AS gameTitle, r.review_contents AS reviewContents, TO_CHAR(r.write_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS writeDate, r.rating AS rating FROM gemdori_review_tbl r JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON r.game_code = g.game_code WHERE r.user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY r.write_date DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
